machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Panel titles on the provisioned `Service health` dashboard (Home > Dashboards > Bench > Service health), exactly as shown: **"Request rate"**, **"Error count"**, **"Latency by endpoint"** (3 panels).

**2. DONE** — New dashboard **`vgr2v-n1 Bench Dashboard`** created and saved, containing a **Stat** panel titled **`vgr2v-n1 Availability`** whose query uses the **TestData** data source (Random Walk scenario; the panel renders live TestData values, e.g. 91.8 on final load). Confirmed in view mode and in the saved JSON model.

**3. DONE** — The same dashboard contains a **Text** panel titled **`vgr2v-n1 Notes`** with content **"Bench notes for run vgr2v-n1"** (contains the runid). Saved; verified rendering in the live DOM after a fresh reload.

**4. DONE** — Dashboard tag **`bench`** added (verified as a tag chip in Dashboard settings > General > Tags after a fresh reload, and as `"tags": ["bench"]` in the saved JSON model). Time range set to **Last 6 hours** and persisted via the save dialog's "Update default time range" checkbox (Changes → 1 before Save). Saved JSON confirms `"time": {"from": "now-6h", "to": "now"}`; the time picker shows "Last 6 hours" on a fresh load.

**5. DONE** — Auto-refresh interval set to **`1m`** and persisted via the save dialog's "Update default refresh value" checkbox. Saved JSON model confirms top-level `"refresh": "1m"`; the top-bar refresh picker shows "1m" (aria-label: "current interval 1 minute selected") on a fresh load.

**6. DONE** — URL read from the browser address bar: **http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/dfza7can2xjpcd/vgr2v-n1-bench-dashboard** (Grafana re-appends its state params on every load, so the bar reads `...?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`). Dashboard **UID: `dfza7can2xjpcd`** (dashboard id 3).

Notes: All saves were confirmed with Grafana's "Dashboard saved" alert; one save hit a stale-version prompt which was resolved with "Save and overwrite". Persistence of every setting was verified against the dashboard's saved JSON model (refresh, time, tags, uid) rather than just the top-bar UI.
